screener.formula: 30% sourced supply-chain exploratory Alpha (if 45%+ coverage), 20% price monitor, 20% revenue growth, 15% inverse P/S, 5% log market cap, 10% inverse realized volatility; available weights renormalized, min 75% and at least one fundamental factor
screener.warning: Not a return forecast. Price×SEC shares is indicative, stale-share/ADR/split checks are required before live investing. Revenue data from 10-K/20-F as filed.

backtest.signal: 30% 5-session momentum + 40% 20-session XLK-excess + 20% 60-session momentum + 10% inverse realized volatility percentile; no fundamentals or current Alpha
backtest.rebalance: monthly, next-trading-day close fill after prior-close signal
backtest.risk: equal weight top 8, max 3 names per sector, no leverage
limitations: Current 40-stock universe used historically: strong survivorship/selection bias
No delisted securities, adjusted dividends or splits separately audited; provider close data as delivered
No intraday fill or market-impact estimates; close-price execution assumes liquidity
Realized returns based on prior-day signals with one-session close execution lag
SEC as-filed fundamentals and 2026 M7 supply Alpha NOT incorporated in historical returns
Short historical window (up to 330 calendar days): insufficient to validate a robust trading edge

prospective_screen_portfolio.first_eligible_execution: next completed US session close after signal snapshot; not a filled order
prospective_screen_portfolio.rebalancing: monthly by current SEC+Alpha screening (full historical backtest not available)
prospective_screen_portfolio.audit: This is a forward research watch basket; do not interpret as historical performance or real trades.

separation_rule: Current 2026 supply Alpha/revenue metrics are NEVER fed into historical price-only backtest. To backtest the full ranking, accumulate or reconstruct as-filed metrics and point-in-time graph edges.
not_included: historical fundamentals published after each rebalance
